lines.raw_line: # Three concentric rings of text. In the centre are two fish (the astrological
# symbol for Pisces), two stars, a ``word'' of Voynich text and the word Mars
# in the Roman alphabet. Mars is French for March, Pisces is February 20th to
# Between the inner ring and the middle ring are ten female(?) figures, each
# beside a barrel and holding a star. Between the middle and the outer ring
# are 19 (NOT 20) female figures, each standing in a barrel and holding a star
# Each of the figures in the 29 figures is labelled with a "word" or phrase
# Nymph labels. Clock position is that of nymph (approx).
# Three rings of circular text, locus indications C1 to C3 (outer
# to inner) and thirty labled nymphs. Inside inner ring the
# emblem of Gemini: two persons holding each other's hands.
# Inside two rings: full circles with labeled nymphs. Five more
# of them are found on top of the outer ring.
# Three nymphs (outer complete ring) are standing on top of
# barrels similar to those of the previous pages.
# There is a nymph without a name here. Consequently, the
# label numbers are now one less than Petersen's nymph numbers
# Four circular bands, locus indications C1 to C4 (outer
# to inner). Three rings of labelled nymphs, 30 in total
# counting inner to outer (cf. Petersen). Clock position
# for labels is that of nymph.
# Part of the start of C1 could be missing
# Three circular bands, locus indications C1 to C3 (outer
# to inner). Two rings of labelled nymphs, 30 in total
# counting inner to outer (cf. Petersen). Clock position
# for labels is that of nymph.
# in the following locus, add six characters (STA) from v101: .chlyiintee
# Three circular bands, locus indications C1 to C3 (outer
# to inner). Two rings of labelled nymphs, 30 in total
# counting inner to outer (cf. Petersen). Clock position
# for labels is that of nymph.
# Added from v101: y.o becomes y.che??.o after ar?k?aly
# Three circular bands, locus indications C1 to C3 (outer
# to inner). C2 start point suggested by ThP ignored and vertical
# Two rings of labelled nymphs, 30 in total
# counting inner to outer (cf. Petersen). Clock position
# for labels is that of nymph.
# Three circular bands, locus indications C1 to C3 (outer
# to inner). Two full rings of labelled nymphs and one short
# third section, 30 in total counting inner to outer (cf.
# Petersen). Clock position for labels is that of nymph.
# Three circular bands, locus indications C1 to C3 (outer
# to inner). Two full rings of labelled nymphs and one short
# third section, 30 in total counting inner to outer (cf.
# Petersen). Clock position for labels is that of nymph.
